paragraphs.en: As an {artist} who shares her {journey} on social media, I'm often asked by {curious} {followers} how to begin an art journey. {Unfortunately} , there is no {magic} list I can offer.I do remember, though, what it was like to be a complete {beginner} .It can feel both {amazing} and {awkward} .At first, you might feel that any real skill is {absent} , and you may feel {bitter} about not reaching your goal as quickly as you'd hoped.So I've put together some good tips for starting an art journey.
paragraphs.cn: 作为一名在社交媒体上分享自己艺术 <u> 历程 </u> 的 <u> 艺术家 </u> ，我经常被 <u> 好奇的粉丝 </u> 们问及如何开启艺术之旅。 <u> 很遗憾 </u> ，我没办法给他们提供一份 <u> 魔法 </u> 清单。不过，我的确记得自己完全是个 <u> 新手 </u> 时的情形。那种感觉既 <u> 美妙 </u> 又 <u> 令人不知所措 </u> 。一开始，你可能觉得自己 <u> 缺乏 </u> 真正的技巧，还会因为没能像自己期望的那样迅速达成目标而感到 <u> 沮丧 </u> 。所以，我整理了一些开启艺术之旅的实用建议。

paragraphs.en: Start small.I suggest using a sketchbook ( (素描本) ) for small studies.These small studies provide {inspiration} and may be a {springboard} for more complex works in the future.Don't throw away your {amateur} art.It's important to {acknowledge} that art is a long journey.You'll want to look back on your journey to see how far you've come.
paragraphs.cn: 从小处着手。我建议使用素描本进行小幅习作。这些习作能带来 <u> 灵感 </u> ，或许日后还会成为创作更复杂作品的 <u> 跳板 </u> 。不要扔掉你 <u> 业余 </u> 水平的画作。重要的是要 <u> 承认 </u> ，艺术之路是漫长的。你会希望回顾自己的历程，看看自己取得了多大的进步。

paragraphs.en: Paint often and paint from life.There's no better way to improve than to put in those {brush} miles.Whether you paint {still} life, {portraits} , or landscapes, paint from life as much as possible even when you get {bored} .By {capturing} the details of a {flower} or a {fruit} , you will develop a better understanding of light and {shadow} .The painting muscle memory only comes with repetition.
paragraphs.cn: 经常画画，而且要写生。没有比多动 <u> 笔 </u> 更好的精进方法了。无论你画的是 <u> 静 </u> 物、 <u> 肖像 </u> 还是风景，即使你会感到 <u> 无聊 </u> ，也要尽可能多地写生。通过 <u> 捕捉花朵 </u> 或 <u> 水果 </u> 的细节，你将更好地理解光 <u> 影 </u> 的原理。绘画的肌肉记忆只会随着重复而形成。

paragraphs.en: {Continually} challenge yourself to try something new.Get out of your comfort zone. {Artistic} growth can be a bit {painful} .You may {doubt} how it will turn out.Welcome to the club; we've all been there.Many artists find that their {ambition} grows once they experiment with different materials or tools—this is often how the most {extraordinary} works of art are born. {Anybody} willing to learn can succeed in {attaining} new levels of expression.When you {anticipate} challenges, you may find that the results are more rewarding than you expected.
paragraphs.cn: <u> 不断 </u> 挑战自己，尝试新的事物。走出你的舒适区。 <u> 艺术的 </u> 成长可能会有点 <u> 痛苦 </u> 。你可能会 <u> 怀疑 </u> 最终的成效。欢迎成为我们中的一员——大家都有过这样的处境。许多艺术家发现，一旦尝试了不同的材料或工具，他们的 <u> 野心 </u> 就会增长——最 <u> 非凡的 </u> 艺术作品通常就是这样诞生的。只要愿意学习， <u> 任何人 </u> 都可以成功地 <u> 达到 </u> 新的艺术表现水平。当你 <u> 预料 </u> 到会有挑战时，你会发现结果比你所预期的更令人满意。

paragraphs.en: Share your work if you feel comfortable doing so.It's a good way to {advertise} your passion for painting.One of the most difficult things is the fear of being {judged} .But seeking and accepting {constructive} feedback ( (反馈) ) is crucial to growth.I post my work on social media and, in turn, have met some of the kindest people.They make me feel valued and {respected} , no matter my level of artistic ability.
paragraphs.cn: 在感到自在的前提下分享你的作品。这是 <u> 宣传 </u> 你对绘画的热情的好方法。害怕被 <u> 评判 </u> 是最困难的事情之一。但寻求和接受 <u> 建设性的 </u> 反馈对你的成长至关重要。我在社交媒体上发布了我的作品，因而遇到了一些最善良的人。无论我的艺术造诣如何，他们都让我感到自己受到重视和 <u> 尊重 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: The journey you're on won't follow a straight path.You'll hit {roadblocks} , and you'll feel discouraged at times.Push through, give it time and put in the effort.You will {harvest} the rewards of an artistic life.
paragraphs.cn: 你所踏上的旅程并非一帆风顺。你会遇到 <u> 阻碍 </u> ，有时还会感到气馁。坚持下去，耐心等待，并付出努力。你终将 <u> 收获 </u> 艺术人生的回馈。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
